opening_message:
Ticket 1: Dominic Taylor (employee ID E004) requests write access to Source Code.

Team memory: 2 note(s) about employee E004.
Note 1 (ticket 1), written by HR agent:
  - role: Engineer
  - employment type: contractor
  - recommendation for Source Code: read
  - comment: Dominic Taylor (E004) is a contractor in the Engineer role. Contractors max out at read unless they have advanced security training, which is not in HR records. Write access would only be permissible if the Security agent confirms advanced training. Recommend read pending that confirmation.
Note 2 (ticket 1), written by Security agent:
  - role: Engineer
  - employment type: contractor
  - security training: basic
  - recommendation for Source Code: read
  - comment: Security record confirms E004 is a contractor with basic security training (not advanced). Per policy, contractors can have write only with advanced training, so the maximum is read. Requested write exceeds the maximum; recommend read.

Since advanced training is not confirmed, the maximum allowed level is read. The requested write exceeds the maximum, so the maximum (read) is granted.
